entities.summary: Bogovë Nature Park is a nature park in southern Albania, spanning an area of 3.3 km2 (1.3 sq mi). It was established in 1977 to protect several ecosystems and biodiversity of national importance. The nature park of Bogovë falls inside the Pindus Mountains mixed forests terrestrial ecoregion of the Palearctic Mediterranean forests, woodlands, and scrub biome.
